title: Toggle Link Chain
metal: 18k gold tone (PVD 18k gold tone coating on surgical stainless steel), polished, one tone only
lock: A 50 cm chain, 4 mm wide, of elongated paperclip links (about 4 x 11 mm) in polished 18k gold tone. 1 thick round spring-gate sailor ring about 22 mm across (about 14 mm opening, small push-pin nub, ribbed gate collar) and 1 short straight bar about 15 mm long set with 1 row of about 9 tiny clear stones, on a jump ring. No pendant, no other stones. Must stay a sailor ring with a straight bar 0.6-0.7x the ring, never a plain donut ring, a lobster clasp, or a curved or multi-row pave bar.
morph: The clasp. The spring-gate sailor ring gets smoothed into a plain donut (listing photo 03, itself AI-generated, already shows this) or swapped for a lobster clasp; the bar grows as long as the ring, curves, or turns into a 2-3-row pave crescent (also in photo 03).
sizeMm: Listed: chain 500 mm long x 4 mm wide, 12 g; toggle ring about 22 mm across, bar about 15 mm. Estimated from the studio worn photo (01): links about 4 x 11 mm, ring opening about 14 mm, ring tube about 4 mm. Referent: the ring is a little larger than a Rs 1 coin (20 mm); on the body the 50 cm length falls just below the collarbone (size guide: between princess 45 cm and matinee 60 cm), with the ring at the base of the throat.
refNotes: Reused the ads-500 ids from products.md after checking they match the current listing. Ref 1 (cube packshot) is pixel-identical to listing image 02 (toggle-link-chain-1.jpg). Ref 2 (clasp close-up on skin) is a crop of listing image 01 (toggle-link-chain-0), and RULINGS names it the clasp standard. It shows the sailor gate, push-pin nub and the 1-row stone bar against skin for scale.
claims: Tarnish Free, Hypoallergenic (both tagged). Waterproof is tagged as well, but the care text says 'Keep it dry', so the concept-50 plan rules out any waterproof claim and any water imagery for this piece.
variants: 1 variant: Default Title, stock 77, 18k gold tone. Show it (every photo is this variant).
copyNotes: Use: 18k gold tone, PVD, surgical stainless steel, paperclip links, toggle clasp, sailor ring, cubic zirconia (only for the bar's stones), 50 cm, 4 mm, 'closes with a turn rather than a catch', 'turn the toggle to the front'. Avoid: 'gold' alone and the listing's 'gold toggle clasp' as written (say 'gold-tone toggle clasp'), solid gold, waterproof or water imagery, anti-tarnish, 'zero stones' or 'no stones', diamond, pendant, lobster, cable or curb chain, huggie. Note: the listing text never mentions the stones on the bar, which every real photo shows.
story: A chain that closes with a turn, not a catch, and the clasp is the jewel. Turned to the front, the chunky sailor ring and its small stone-set bar become the pendant on plain paperclip links (founder keep: 'Paperclip, promoted.'). Rhymes with a sailor's shackle, a key ring, a door-knocker ring, a duffle-coat toggle: two parts that lock into one. Wear it over a knit in winter or alone on a warm evening. It is the stock anchor at Rs 999 (77 units) and the named BUY3 anchor.

Packshot draped over a plaster cube on a cream ground. The whole chain and ring show clearly; the bar is seen end-on. 18k gold tone. Same image as the ads-500 cube ref.
